title: Customer-Pay Repairs Notice on Storage of Uncollected Vehicles
content:
Storage is charged when a ready vehicle, or the vehicle of a cancelled job, is not collected in time. The vehicle is still at the center more than the tier's free days after the ready date. Days are calendar days counted from the ready date (or the cancellation date) as day zero; the first billed day is the day after the last free day. Storage posts as one charge on the collection date at the tier's daily storage rate per calendar day for the first billed day through the last billed day inclusive.

This notice applies to vehicles repaired, or held for a cancelled job, under Customer-Pay Repairs.

## Elements

- **Clock starts**: the ready date recorded on the repair order (for a cancelled job, the cancellation date), which is day zero.
- **Counting**: calendar days.
- **Comparison**: storage arises only when the vehicle is still at the center more than the free days after the ready date; being collected on the last free day incurs none.
- **Amount**: the number of calendar days from the first billed day through the last billed day, both included, multiplied by the tier's daily storage rate, posted as one charge on the collection date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; 3 free days, ready date 2026-07-06)

| Calendar day | Date | Status of the day |
|---|---|---|
| day zero | 2026-07-06 | ready date |
| days 1 to 3 | 2026-07-07 to 2026-07-09 | free |
| day 4 | 2026-07-10 | first billed day |

- Collected on 2026-07-09 (day 3, the last free day): not more than 3 days after the ready date, no storage.
- Still at the center on 2026-07-10 (day 4): more than 3 days after the ready date, storage is charged from 2026-07-10.

## Worked amount (hypothetical; daily rate 45.00)

A billed period from 2026-07-10 through 2026-07-13 inclusive is 4 calendar days; at 45.00 a day the storage charge is 180.00, posted as one charge on the collection date.
